title: Replacing sick men: Johnny 'Bugs' Hamilton and Bill Coleman
summary: In the big band a sick player was covered by the others, but the six-piece needed substitutes; Hamilton and Bill Coleman filled in for Autrey, and he tells how Hamilton got his nickname.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: In a case like that, were you sometimes in the group along with Johnny Buggs?
Yes, he came in, but I mean I was the main one.
You were carrying two trumpets then, right then.
Yes, I mean he would come in, but not in the six-piece group. Not in that. This was the big band.
Oh, the big band.
Yeah. When they -- one night here, one night there.
Well, when something like that happened, when somebody gets sick, and you had to leave them, what would you do? Pick up a local musician wherever you went? Or --
No, no, we would -- no, because there's usually a few days or a week, and the two trumpets, with the rest of the guys, they could carry them.
How about the six-piece group. Did you have to -- if something happened to somebody there, would you --
No, that had to be replaced. I mean Johnny 'Bugs' replaced me. I had what, flu, or a cold, or something, and Johnny 'Bugs' and what's his name? He's in Europe now, still in Paris. Coleman.
Bill Coleman, yeah. Uh-huh.
Yeah, hm, and for a few days -- and have a date, or a recording date or something, he would replace me, and everything.
And if you're on the road, did you send to New York for somebody? Or did you pick up a local --
Well that didn't happen to me on the road. No.
Why was he called Johnny 'Bugs'?
Johnny told me that story himself. When he was a little baby crawling around on the floor he say he used to eat every bug he could catch.
(Laughter.)
Now whether he was lying or not, and I think -- [he had a nasty mouth] you know?
(Laughter.)
That's a wonderful --
And -- so he was a damned good trumpet
player, you know. Oh, I thought the world, people, Fats and all of them thought a heck of a lot of Bugs, and he was a very nice guy. Uh-huh.
